packageRules.description: Confluent packages depend on matching client versions; update the release train together

Microsoft.Extensions.*, EF Core and System.* versions follow each target framework's major (Directory.Packages.props has one entry per TFM); adding a new major means adding a new target framework, so do that by hand
Keep the .NET 10 runtime required by net10.0 binaries; global.json controls SDK upgrades
